items.markdown:
Shot density, often measured in shots per foot (SPF), is `the number of perforation holes created in a well casing to connect the reservoir with the wellbore` . High-shot density guns (typically>4 is greater than 4>4 SPF) improve fluid flow by increasing the total open area, often utilizing optimized phasing (e.g., [[HSD systems](https://www.google.com/search?q=HSD+systems&csui=3&hl=en&gl=US&uule=w+CAIQIFISCQs2MuSEtepUEUK33kOSuTsc&ved=2ahUKEwjFmZv9lZGUAxUDUlUIHa_DGskQgK4QegQIARAE) ](https://www.slb.com/products-and-services/innovating-in-oil-and-gas/completions/well-completions/perforating/perforating-gun-systems/hollow-carrier/hsd-high-shot-density-perforating-gun-system) or [[UZI systems](https://www.google.com/search?q=UZI+systems&csui=3&hl=en&gl=US&uule=w+CAIQIFISCQs2MuSEtepUEUK33kOSuTsc&ved=2ahUKEwjFmZv9lZGUAxUDUlUIHa_DGskQgK4QegQIARAG) ](https://www.corelab.com/products/uzi/)).[[1]](https://www.slb.com/products-and-services/innovating-in-oil-and-gas/completions/well-completions/perforating/perforating-gun-systems/hollow-carrier/hsd-high-shot-density-perforating-gun-system#:~:text=Related%20products,from%201.56%20to%207%20in.)[[2]](https://glossary.slb.com/terms/p/perforation_density#:~:text=The%20number%20of%20perforations%20per,an%208%20spf%20casing%20gun.)[[3]](https://iaeme.com/MasterAdmin/Journal_uploads/IJMET/VOLUME_10_ISSUE_3/IJMET_10_03_193.pdf#:~:text=This%20is%20the%20number%20of%20holes%20expressed,balances%20the%20increased%20cost%20of%20well%20%5B3%5D.)[[4]](https://www.corelab.com/products/uzi/#:~:text=The%20Owen%20Oil%20Tools'%20UZI,affect%20your%20downhole%20flow%20performance.)[[5]](https://glossary.slb.com/terms/h/high-shot_density_gun#:~:text=1.%20n.%20%5BPerforating%5D,terms:%20carrier%20gun%2C%20perforating%20gun)

**Key Aspects of Shot Density in Perforating** 

- **Definition:** The number of perforation tunnels created per linear foot of the gun.
- **High-Shot Density (HSD):** Defined as systems creating more than four holes per foot, which enhances, but [[high-shot density guns](https://www.google.com/search?q=high-shot+density+guns&csui=3&hl=en&gl=US&uule=w+CAIQIFISCQs2MuSEtepUEUK33kOSuTsc&ved=2ahUKEwjFmZv9lZGUAxUDUlUIHa_DGskQgK4QegQIAxAE) ](https://glossary.slb.com/terms/h/high-shot_density_gun) also improve the phasing, or distribution of perforations, around the wellbore, maximizing radial coverage.
- **Productivity Impact:** Higher density reduces the pressure differential needed for fluid to flow, lowering skin effect (damage) and improving inflow performance.
- **Application-Specific Use:** 
	- **Sand Control:** High density and large holes are preferred to reduce flow velocity and sand production.
	- **Cement Evaluation:** Specialized systems like the [UZI system](https://www.google.com/search?q=UZI+system&csui=3&hl=en&gl=US&uule=w+CAIQIFISCQs2MuSEtepUEUK33kOSuTsc&ved=2ahUKEwjFmZv9lZGUAxUDUlUIHa_DGskQgK4QegQIAxAJ) (up to 36 SPF) are used for cement channeling identification.
	- **Formation Type:** High density is vital for maximizing flow, while deep penetration (often lower density) is better for heavily damaged zones.
- **Performance Factors:** Effective shot density can be reduced by debris, charge misfires, or poor gun orientation.[[1]](https://glossary.slb.com/terms/h/high-shot_density_gun#:~:text=1.%20n.%20%5BPerforating%5D,terms:%20carrier%20gun%2C%20perforating%20gun)[[2]](https://www.repeatprecision.com/products/perforating-guns#:~:text=How%20does%20shot%20density%20affect,your%20formation%20and%20production%20goals.)[[3]](https://www.corelab.com/energetics/)[[4]](https://iaeme.com/MasterAdmin/Journal_uploads/IJMET/VOLUME_10_ISSUE_3/IJMET_10_03_193.pdf#:~:text=This%20is%20the%20number%20of%20holes%20expressed,balances%20the%20increased%20cost%20of%20well%20%5B3%5D.)[[5]](https://www.slb.com/zh-cn/resource-library/oilfield-review/defining-series/defining-perforating#:~:text=For%20instance%2C%20formations%20that%20are,a%20safe%20and%20secure%20manner.)[[6]](https://www.corelab.com/products/uzi/#:~:text=The%20Owen%20Oil%20Tools'%20UZI,affect%20your%20downhole%20flow%20performance.)[[7]](https://glossary.slb.com/terms/e/effective_shot_density#:~:text=1.%20n.%20%5BPerforating%5D,to%20calculate%20likely%20productivity%20response.)

**Typical Configurations** 

- **Low to Moderate:** 4-8 SPF.
- **High Density:** 8-12+ SPF.
- **Ultra-High Density:** 12-36+ SPF.[[1]](https://www.corelab.com/products/uzi/#:~:text=The%20Owen%20Oil%20Tools'%20UZI,affect%20your%20downhole%20flow%20performance.)[[2]](https://glossary.slb.com/terms/p/perforation_density#:~:text=The%20number%20of%20perforations%20per,an%208%20spf%20casing%20gun.)
